source: Synthetic QuickBooks-shaped hackathon dataset; company-029; YAML consolidated to JSON
notes: USD amounts preserve source decimal strings.
One company only; simulation hidden ground truth excluded.
Historical books are not a forward cash forecast.
Receivables and retainage are not settled cash.
Do not double count bank transactions against invoices, bills, or payroll.

company.industry_title: New Single-Family Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders)

accounts.name: Business Checking
accounts.description: Operating bank account; every settlement moves through it.

accounts.name: Accounts Receivable
accounts.description: Amounts invoiced to customers and not yet collected.

accounts.name: Inventory Asset
accounts.description: Goods bought for resale, held at cost until sold.

accounts.name: Work in Progress
accounts.description: Project costs incurred and not yet recognized against revenue.

accounts.name: Retainage Receivable
accounts.description: Amounts earned but withheld by clients until a project completes.

accounts.name: Equipment
accounts.description: Equipment owned by the business, at cost.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation
accounts.description: Depreciation charged against owned equipment to date.

accounts.name: Accounts Payable
accounts.description: Amounts billed by vendors and not yet paid.

accounts.name: Wages Payable
accounts.description: Wages earned by employees and not yet paid.

accounts.name: Credit Card
accounts.description: Revolving card balance drawn against short-term costs.

accounts.name: Line of Credit
accounts.description: Drawn principal on the operating credit line.

accounts.name: Accrued Interest
accounts.description: Interest incurred but not yet billed by the lender.

accounts.name: Income Tax Payable
accounts.description: Assessed income tax not yet paid.

accounts.name: Customer Deposits
accounts.description: Client money held before the work it pays for is earned.

accounts.name: Undeposited Funds
accounts.description: Card takings captured at the register and not yet settled to the bank.

accounts.name: Opening Balance Equity
accounts.description: The owner's starting stake, recorded once when the books open.

accounts.name: Owner Distributions
accounts.description: Cash the owner has drawn out of the business; reduces equity.

accounts.name: Construction Income
accounts.description: Revenue recognized on accepted project milestones.

accounts.name: Cost of Goods Sold
accounts.description: Cost of the goods sold, recognized as each sale is delivered.

accounts.name: Job Materials
accounts.description: Materials consumed on projects.

accounts.name: Subcontractors
accounts.description: Trade contractors engaged to carry out project work.

accounts.name: Equipment Rental
accounts.description: Plant and machinery hired for project work.

accounts.name: Wage Expense
accounts.description: Wages earned by employees, recognized when they are earned.

accounts.name: Project Manager Wages
accounts.description: Supervision payroll, carried as overhead rather than against a job.

accounts.name: Operating Expense
accounts.description: Routine running costs not separately classified.

accounts.name: Rent and Lease
accounts.description: Premises rent and lease costs.

accounts.name: Utilities
accounts.description: Electricity, water and other metered supply.

accounts.name: Insurance
accounts.description: Business and project insurance premiums.

accounts.name: Repairs and Maintenance
accounts.description: Upkeep of premises and equipment.

accounts.name: Advertising and Marketing
accounts.description: Campaigns and outreach intended to win work.

accounts.name: Legal and Professional Fees
accounts.description: Accountancy, legal, estimating and similar engaged services.

accounts.name: Shipping and Delivery
accounts.description: Outbound carriage on customer shipments.

accounts.name: Taxes and Licenses
accounts.description: Permits, licences and statutory fees other than income tax.

accounts.name: Bad Debts
accounts.description: Receivables judged uncollectable and written off.

accounts.name: Depreciation
accounts.description: Periodic charge spreading equipment cost over its working life.

accounts.name: Interest Expense
accounts.description: Interest on drawn credit.

accounts.name: Income Tax Expense
accounts.description: Income tax assessed on the period's profit.
